name: Four-objective selection
task: Compare two invented deck candidates using enjoyment, functional opening, eligible prize and match performance as separate axes. Vary the player's priorities and identify the choice that changes.

name: Opening density audit
task: Calculate access for 7–12 eligible cards in a 39-card population with seven distinct observations; compare marginal gain to the displaced slot. Then alter the sampling assumption.

name: Missed-opener recovery
task: Create two abstract opening failure states. Identify a legal defensive bridge and the earliest credible stabilization; record the opponent's independent options.

name: Rune stress test
task: Compare 6/6, 7/5 and 8/4 partitions at six random draws. Add one prior required-domain expenditure and distinguish access from payable resources.

name: Dependency fault injection
task: Remove a threat, modifier or engine from a hypothetical sequence one at a time. Compare independent utility and filtering alternatives under the same resource budget.

name: Gauntlet regression
task: Freeze a baseline and a single slot change. Design paired tests across six historical archetype labels plus two unknown variants; log result, pilot, version and causes, without inventing outcomes.

name: Pre-event decision memo
task: Set an explicit minimum readiness threshold, then compare an unproven candidate against a familiar fallback with remaining preparation time. Document why either choice could be rational.
